name: @latticekit/site
description: The landing page. Not part of the kit, not a workspace member, and nothing here may be imported by a package or an exhibit.
$comment: Deliberately NOT in the root `workspaces` array. The page is not shipped, must never become a dependency of anything under packages/ or examples/, and adding it to the workspace would put it in every contributor's install for no benefit. It resolves @latticekit/* through the symlinks the workspace already made in the root node_modules, and it runs Vite and TypeScript out of the root devDependencies — so it has no node_modules of its own and nothing to install. Adding it to the root package.json is a change this page's author does not own; see the report.
